answer: A Sybil defense ties each agent identity to a stake forfeited whole when it is caught colluding with a sibling. Think of a harbor where every new ship must dock a bond before trading: an attacker importing ten thousand puppet agents cannot reuse one deposit, because the ledger keys the lien to a fingerprint of key and history, so cloning a wallet forks the record and orphans the stake, and the price becomes a spiral. Honest operators treat the lock as a haven, but the attacker must fund each fake alone and lose all if one is caught. Cost scales linearly, pricing out a raid.
